Note: Applicants with degrees in related fields, such as those listed above, who do not have the 12 semester hrs. of specified course work must have had at least 1 yr. of work experience in community planning acquired under the supervision & guidance of a community planner. -OR- B.

Combination of Education & Experience: Courses equivalent to a major in one of the above disciplines, or a combination of related courses totaling at least 24 semester hrs. in any combination of the above disciplines of which at least 12 semester hrs. were in the planning process, & socioeconomic & physical elements of planning, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

Basic Requirements for General Engineering Series 0801: A. Degree: Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in engineering.

To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential & integral calculus and courses in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields & circuits; (f) nature & properties of materials; & (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics. -OR- B.

Combination of Education & Experience: College-level education, training, &/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, & (2) a good understanding, both theoretical & practical, of the engineering sciences & techniques & their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: 1. Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions. 2.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico. 3.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, & engineering sciences & that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A. 4.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions. Basic Requirements for Landscape Architecture Series 0807: A.

Degree: Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in landscape architecture or landscape design. -OR- B.

Combination of Education & Experience: For each year short of graduation, the applicant must have had 1 yr of experience under professional leadership & guidance of such character & diversity as to be a satisfactory substitute for the required education.

This experience must have included original landscape design. ** See Education Section for additional qualification requirements**

Bei ewz Energielösungen engagieren wir uns mit Überzeugung für Netto Null - gestalte diesen Wandel mit uns und bringe als Business Engineer & Projektleiter\*in Digitalisierung deine Ideen an der Schnittstelle von Business und IT ein, um die Energiezukunft Zürichs aktiv mitzugestalten.
## Aufgaben ##
* Du erarbeitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen für neue Lösungen und berätst Bereichsleitung sowie Stakeholder bei der Systemintegration.
* Gemeinsam mit dem Architekturteam entwickelst du die Geschäftsbereichsarchitektur - bestehend aus Prozessen, Applikationen, Daten und Technologie - weiter.
* Du leitest Digitalisierungsprojekte kompetent von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung.
* Die Vernetzung von IT, Fachbereich und externen Partnern sowie die Vertretung von Energielösungen in ewz-weiten Architekturgremien gehören zu deinen Kernaufgaben.
* Du pflegst die Architekturlandkarte und sorgst für konsistente Dokumentation, Governance und Compliance im Geschäftsbereich.
## Profil ##
* Du bringst ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder eine adäquate Aus- oder Weiterbildung mit.
* In der Geschäftsprozessanalyse, der agilen Softwareentwicklung und im Projektmanagement verfügst du über fundierte Kenntnisse.
* Erfahrung in der Leitung heterogener Projektteams und im Stakeholder-Management, idealerweise in der Energie-, Gebäudetechnik- oder Immobilienbranche, hast du bereits gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über stilsichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und überzeugst durch eine klare Kommunikation sowie die Fähigkeit, auch unter Druck den Überblick zu behalten.
* Analytisches und vernetztes Denken sowie hohe Eigeninitiative zeichnen dich aus, ebenso wie die Freude an komplexen, technisch-fachlichen Fragestellungen.
## Wir bieten ##
* Mehr Energie für dein Leben: Durch mobiles Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und Teilzeitmöglichkeiten kannst du deine Arbeitszeit aktiv mitgestalten und sie so einteilen, wie sie am besten zu deinem Leben passt. Du kannst beispielsweise bis zu 2 Wochen zusätzliche Ferien einkaufen und auf allen Stufen Teilzeit arbeiten. Auch Jobsharing/-splitting und unbezahlter Urlaub sind bei uns natürlich möglich.
* Nachhaltig und vergünstigt reisen: Mit dem Mobilitätsbeitrag von bis zu 600 Franken im Jahr reist du günstig und nachhaltig - egal, ob du mit dem Velo durch Zürich radeln oder mit dem Zug die Schweiz erkunden willst.
* Eine Investition in deine Zukunft: Wir legen nicht nur Wert darauf, faire und transparente Löhne zu zahlen, sondern stellen auch sicher, dass dir von deinem Lohn mehr übrigbleibt. Wir übernehmen 60% der Sparbeiträge und bieten zusätzlich einen überobligatorischen Zins auf das angesparte Kapital.
* Ein Energieschub für deine Freizeit: Wir zahlen dir monatlich 100 Franken auf deine Lunch-Check Karte ein. Zudem profitierst du jährlich von weiteren Fringe Benefits im Wert von 150 Franken und von attraktiven Handyabos.
* Entwicklung und Weiterbildung: Mit unserem Talentmanagement gehen wir deine Entwicklung aktiv an. Du profitierst von vielseitigen internen und externen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.
* Sinnhafte Arbeit: Nachhaltigkeit und sinnstiftende Arbeit sind bei uns nicht nur Worte: Gestalte bei uns Zürich und die Zukunft mit. Setze gemeinsam mit uns Energie für ein gutes Morgen frei.

Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.
Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. We are seeking an experienced Civil & Interior Project professional to lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of projects with high end finishes. The role spans civil finishes works, interior works (joinery, finishes, MEP coordination), cost & schedule control, vendor management, and quality & safety compliance. The ideal candidate has hands-on site leadership, strong stakeholder communication, and demonstrable delivery of multi-site/commercial projects.

Project Planning & Coordination
Prepare and manage project plans, timelines, and work breakdown structures (WBS); track milestones.
Conduct feasibility, site readiness assessments, and method statements; plan sequencing of civil and interior activities.
Coordinate MEP interfaces with civil finishes (HVAC, electrical and lighting, plumbing fixtures, fire safety systems etc).
Drive design development and shop drawings review; ensure GFC (Good for Construction) drawing alignment.
Civil Works Execution
Oversee structural alterations, flooring, waterproofing, masonry, plastering, Flooring works (Granite/tiles/vinyl/epoxy etc), cladding (Granite/Marble/Wooden etc), painting; ensure compliance with IS codes and NBC India.
Interiors / Fit-Out Delivery
Supervise joinery, modular furniture, partitions (gypsum/glass), ceilings, wall treatments, veneers, laminates, stone, metal, and soft finishes.
Ensure sample approvals, mock-ups, material submittals, and finish schedules; maintain snag lists and close-out.
Coordinate with designers for detail resolution (profiles, skirtings, reveals, edge bands, hardware).
Vendor & Stakeholder Management
Manage subcontractors, supplier performance, and site workforce allocation; resolve site conflicts.
Liaise with client representatives, architects, and consultants; run weekly progress reviews.
Compliance, Safety & Documentation
Enforce EHS and site safety standards (PPE, method statements, tool box talks, risk assessments).
Ensure statutory approvals and municipality norms are adhered to.
Maintain daily logs, measurement books, RFI/RFP trackers, as-built drawings, and handover documentation.
Quality & Handover
Implement quality control plans and benchmarks; conduct mid-project and final inspections.
Drive commissioning (if applicable for MEP), snag rectification, and defects liability follow-up.
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (preferred), or Diploma with strong experience.
Experience: 10+ years in civil & interiors projects (commercial office, retail, hospitality, or high-end residential).

Collaborate with the core team to understand and develop the data center electrical designs, from starting basis of design (BOD) to issue for constructions (IFC), for new data center project build-outs and major infrastructure upgrades.
Navigate construction and Cx issues from HV substation to MV equipment to LV branch circuits.
Work in collaboration with QCx, GC, EC, PM, DCOPs, & Central Engineering Teams to remediate issues, deliver quality installation, and maintain construction schedule.
Manage all power system issues during concept design, detailed design, procurement, bidding, manufacturing, delivery, and installation on site.
Identify and resolve issues raised by the cross-functional teams and various external stakeholders.
Generate scope of work for the equipment portions of major infrastructure upgrades based on project needs. Work with internal teams to update and document the configuration as it evolves.

Update and maintain the internal design specifications, drawings and standards in accordance with the latest configurations and including all 'lessons learned' in relation to all equipment.
Work with EOR for medium voltage duct bank designs.

Inspect medium voltage terminations and work with the site team on all medium voltage needs.
Review pull calculations, walk through cables pulling process and oversee medium voltage cable pulls.

Experience with power systems and electrical testing and standards.

Basic understanding of short circuit coordination & arc-flash (SCCAF) Reports (AF labeling, coordination of protective devices, etc.)

Snowflake is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Talent Management Program Manager to focus on the day-to-day execution and operational support of our global talent programs. This role is essential to the smooth running of our Performance Excellence cycle, ensuring that every phase of the process is coordinated effectively and on schedule.
In this role, you will be the primary "executor" for our established talent milestones. You will handle the logistics for performance review cycles, the administrative coordination of talent and succession reviews, and the delivery of our employee listening surveys.

Additionally, you will serve as the primary system administrator and program owner for our voice AI 360 platform, managing its scaling and cross-functional operational workflows.

This is a perfect role for someone who loves continuous improvement, process, excels at task management, and enjoys building for scale and ensuring that large-scale, global programs run without a hitch.

Drive Performance Excellence: Lead the day-to-day execution of the Performance Excellence cycle — tracking progress against key milestones, sending timely communications and reminders to employees, managers, and global People Team partners at each phase, and ensuring every deadline is met.

Own Workday cycle logistics, including testing new launches, validating system configurations, and resolving user issues before each phase goes live. Equip employees and managers with clear, accessible resources — how-to guides, FAQs, and instructional materials — throughout the process.

Advance ongoing program evolution by gathering cycle feedback, tracking enhancement requests, and coordinating technology and process improvements across platforms.
Coordinate Employee Listening & Pulse Surveys: Manage end-to-end coordination of Employee Voice Survey and pulse survey cycles — from distribution lists and completion tracking to targeted reminders and timely delivery of results to People Business Partners and stakeholders. Equip users with the guidance needed to navigate and act on their results.

Partner with the analytics team on data quality checks, anonymity thresholds, and dashboard updates. Maintain survey calendars, align listening program cadences, and track action item follow-through across cycles.
Voice AI 360 Platform Administration: Serve as the functional system administrator. Manage the admin dashboard, whitelisting coordination, participant/provider invitation tracking, and real-time completion monitoring.
Cross-Functional Stakeholder Interfacing: Act as the primary operational liaison with Procurement and Finance to manage Statement of Work (SOW) legal reviews, purchase orders, budget allocations, and vendor invoicing for platform scaling.
Support Talent & Succession Logistics: Assist in the rollout of talent reviews and succession planning by organizing meeting materials, managing participant lists, and ensuring all data templates are updated and ready for use.
Maintain Program Documentation: Keep our talent "playbooks" and internal resource pages up to date. Ensure that instructional guides and FAQs are accurate and reflect the current process for each cycle — including documentation for the 360 user experience.
System Task Management: Act as a functional user of our talent systems, helping to test new cycle launches and enhancements, and troubleshooting basic user issues.
Communication Support: Draft and distribute routine program updates and announcements. Help create simple, visually clear "how-to" materials (using Google Slides or Canva) to assist employees in navigating our talent tools.
Reporting & Tracking: Pull regular reports to track participation across all talent programs, identifying any gaps in completion, monitoring anonymized Team Insights dashboards, and escalating issues to the team as needed.
Operational Improvement: Provide feedback on the "user experience" of our cycles, suggesting small, practical tweaks to the coordination process to make it more efficient for the next time.

Clear Communicator: Ability to write clear, concise instructions and communicate effectively with global employees, HR partners, and external vendor teams.

About the Role: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Project Manager to drive the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-volume production campaigns for one of the world’s most iconic luxury heritage brands.

This is a highly collaborative, client-facing role where you will act as the trusted partner for client stakeholders and the bridge to our internal production teams. You will own the regional execution of global and local campaigns, ensuring every deliverable is on time, on brand, and on budget and report to the Production Engagement lead

Own the Project Lifecycle: Act as the ultimate authority on project status, resource allocation, budget tracking, and scope management.
Navigate the Ecosystem: Master workflows and platforms to seamlessly guide cross-functional teams through the content production pipeline.
Build Trusted Partnerships: Foster strong, collaborative relationships with clients, agency partners, and internal production specialists.
Execute with Excellence: Balance high-level strategic planning with hands-on execution across lines of business, a broad mix of production deliverables (Video, Print, Digital, Web) and concurrent workstreams.
Champion Global Alignment: Serve as the regional point person for global initiatives, ensuring local execution matches the brand's premium worldwide standards.
Who You Are: You are a proactive communicator and a natural problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You bring a deep passion for marketing, advertising, and production, along with the flexibility to adapt to evolving client needs without losing sight of the details .

Strategic Leadership & Process Optimization
Production Subject Matter Expert: Serve as the definitive internal and external authority on high-volume primary production, delivering swift, strategic, and actionable guidance on all inquiries.
Workflow Optimization: Continuously evaluate and refine internal workflows to maximize productivity, efficiency, and quality across all primary projects.
Implement & Optimize Scalable Solutions: Ensure implementation and optimization of engagement processes to ensure the highly efficient, scalable delivery of video, digital and print content.
End-to-End Project Execution
Lifecycle Management: Oversee the complete project lifecycle—from initiation to final delivery—actively managing scope, creative briefing, and milestone tracking for all primary assets.
Global Collaboration: Author clear, precise, and comprehensive production briefs for onshore and offshore teams, ensuring flawless alignment, accurate execution, and seamless cross-border delivery.
Project Closure: Establish and manage robust project-closing documentation to ensure key learnings and financial reconciliations are captured.
Stakeholder Management & Communication
Cross-Functional Alignment: Lead weekly status meetings with clients, agency partners, and internal teams to maintain absolute transparency, momentum, and alignment.
Proactive Communication: Act as the central communication hub, delivering clear updates on project health, timing, and budgets, while proactively identifying potential blockers and executing swift resolutions.
Accountability & Ownership: Demonstrate a highly proactive, entrepreneurial approach, taking complete personal ownership of project outcomes, timelines, and client satisfaction.

Experience & Industry Expertise: 7+ years of progressive project management or production experience within an integrated creative agency, production house, or similar fast-paced environment. Automotive experience a plus.
Production & Process Knowledge: Deep understanding of the creative development process, primary production pipelines ( video, digital and print), creative technology, QA testing, and modern marketing methodologies.
Financial & Scope Management: Proven experience in bottom-up scoping, building and managing project budgets, tracking actuals, and authoring detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
End-to-End Delivery: Demonstrated ability to manage complex, high-volume projects (or major components of multi- million dollar million-dollar initiatives), consistently delivering on time, on scope, and on budget.
Problem-Solving & Stakeholder Management: A natural problem-solver capable of designing win-win solutions for clients, creative teams, and production partners without compromising creative quality or project integrity.
Leadership & Presence: A calm, confident, and highly accountable leader who thrives under pressure and navigates complex, matrixed agency environments with professionalism and grace.
Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a natural ability to foster collaboration across diverse, cross-functional teams.
Tools & Platforms: High proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), workflow mapping tools (such as Visio), and modern project management/ticketing platforms (e.g., Workfront, JIRA, Smartsheet, SharePoint).
